cases.prompt: Analyse a feature that exists only in code, with no imported sources
assertions: The analysis row records Intended as observed rather than inventing intent
Every claim carries a CODE citation with a line range and hash
The run stops to ask before treating observations as accepted behaviour

cases.prompt: Analyse a feature where the imported doc and the code disagree
assertions: The row is classified divergent, not done or partial
A Conflicts line quotes both the source citation and the code citation
The divergence is raised as a Q record or an ASK-n question, never self-resolved

cases.prompt: Run sw-analyze on a project with registered code roots
assertions: No file under a code root is modified
Only 01-analysis/as-is/ artifacts and manifest code_roots are written

cases.prompt: Check whether a change is really shipped before merging version 1
assertions: One row is produced per acceptance criterion of the change
A gap is reported and blocks the merge instead of passing silently
